about: One hour of shadow reporting: what answer engines told a reader, split into checkable statements in our own words and compared with this site's record. An engine's answer is evidence about the engine, not about the storm. The answers' full text is not here (raw store, outside git: the pointer and sha256 are).

answers.question: charles-lisbon
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: The worst effects are easing for Lisbon; warnings were partly downgraded and the strongest wind moved south
statements.note: the one answer this round that says the storm is passing

statements.text: "Expect periods of heavy rain today"
statements.note: no rain at IPMA's Lisbon stations in the latest hour

answers.told: Yes, but the worst is easing for Lisbon; wind forecasts were reduced in the morning and the strongest gusts moved south.

answers.question: charles-lisbon

statements.text: The city is under a red alert
statements.note: none since 15:00; the press itself reported "Portugal without red warnings" at 18:10

statements.text: How direct the hit will be is still uncertain; gusts of 100 to 150 km/h forecast
statements.note: a forecast at 19:05, three hours after the wind turned west and the pressure began to rise

answers.told: Yes, "expected to affect" Lisbon; the city "is under a red alert"; gusts of 100 to 150 km/h forecast; how direct the hit "is still uncertain".

answers.question: charles-lisbon
answers.asked: A tempestade Charles vai atingir Lisboa?

statements.text: It "will hit" Lisbon; "possible worsening in the critical hours"
statements.note: the future tense at 19:05, from Tuesday's articles; two rounds ago this answer said "is affecting"

statements.text: The track may move south, reducing the impact in Lisbon

answers.told: Yes, "strong indication that it will hit Lisbon"; red warning "in several updates"; the track may move south.

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: What warnings are in force in Lisbon now?
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: Warnings for very heavy rain and strong wind are active for Lisbon right now
statements.note: both ended; cited to IPMA's warnings page and its timeline for Lisbon. No levels and no hours given this time

statements.text: A rough-sea warning, orange or yellow

answers.told: Active warnings for heavy rain, strong wind and rough seas, "high alert levels reported during the day"; the alert situation.

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: What warnings are in force in Lisbon now?

statements.text: Red rain, orange wind and yellow rain are currently active
statements.note: by the answer's own list they ended at 15:00, 18:00 and 18:00; it was written at 19:05

statements.text: Sources reporting that the red rain warning had ended "appear to be older or less current"
statements.note: the engine found the correct, newer reports and set them aside in favour of a stale listing

statements.text: Orange sea warning until 21:00

answers.told: Red rain (until 15:00), orange wind (until 18:00), yellow rain (until 18:00), orange sea (until 21:00), all "currently active"; sources saying they ended "appear to be older".

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: Que avisos estão em vigor em Lisboa agora?

statements.text: Lisbon is now under an orange warning for heavy rain, until 09:00
statements.note: no rain warning stands for Lisbon since 18:00. "Orange until 09:00" was the state on Wednesday before 09:00, nineteen hours earlier, read from an outlet's warnings page

statements.text: IPMA lowered the red rain warnings it had issued for Lisbon
statements.note: the first Portuguese answer to say the red is over; it went to yellow, not orange

statements.text: The alert situation to 23:59

answers.told: An orange warning for heavy rain "until 09:00"; the red rain was lowered to orange; the alert situation to 23:59.

answers.question: madeira
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: The engine did not search

answers.told: No answer, eighth time: it asked which event and timeframe were meant.

answers.question: madeira

statements.text: Floods, landslides, fallen trees; schools and services closed; transport disrupted
statements.note: no count and no rain figure; the Portuguese answer has both

answers.told: Charles: floods, landslides, power damage; schools closed; ferry, cruise and flight cancellations. No figures.

answers.question: madeira

statements.text: 137, 210 and 285 occurrences by time; 479 litres per square metre in 12 hours
A man swept by a stream in Funchal, rescued alive

answers.told: Charles: 137 occurrences to 06:30, 210 to 09:00, 285 to about 13:10; a man rescued alive; 479 litres per square metre in 12 hours.

answers.question: metro
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: The engine did not check; it offered strikes of earlier weeks as "the recent situation"
statements.note: answered with the operator's status page in six rounds before; the storm is not mentioned

answers.told: No answer: it asked "right now or a specific day?", and spoke of strikes in October and November.

answers.question: metro

statements.text: The Metro expects to keep service on Wednesday

answers.told: Yes, running; expected to keep service on Wednesday.

answers.question: metro
answers.asked: O metro de Lisboa está a funcionar?

statements.text: Operation regular, stations open overnight as shelter

answers.told: Yes, running normally, by the Metro and "today's news".

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: "Maybe": organisers aim to resume on Thursday, subject to the authorities' guidance
statements.note: Tuesday night's position, from one article of 10 November; seven hours after the press reported the confirmation, and after this engine itself said Yes at 17:07 and 18:07

answers.told: "Maybe": Thursday is scheduled as Day 3; organisers "aim to resume", "subject to guidance from the authorities"; check before you travel.

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow

statements.text: Yes; the organisers emailed attendees that the summit is back on Thursday for its final day, with many of Wednesday's sessions moved to it
statements.note: right for the third round running in English

answers.told: Yes: on tomorrow, Thursday 12 November, the final day; organisers emailed that the summit "is back tomorrow", with many sessions rescheduled.

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow

statements.text: "Amanhã não se realiza", at 19:05 on Wednesday
statements.note: the same engine at the same minute says Yes in English; third round of the split

statements.text: The organisers "intend to" resume on Thursday
statements.note: the answer cites today's articles on the confirmation only to offer to tell more

answers.told: No: "tomorrow it does not take place"; Wednesday 11 November was cancelled; they "intend to" resume on Thursday.

websummit-tomorrow.text: Web Summit's own page (Tuesday 19:09): Day 2 off, Day 3 "aims to proceed". The press: Thursday confirmed by the organisers; sessions rescheduled; a press conference on Thursday at 11:00. Not read by us at the organisers' page.

lisbon-warnings.text: IPMA: in force for Lisbon at 19:05: orange sea to 21:00, then yellow sea to 03:00. Nothing else: red rain ended 15:00, orange wind 15:56, yellow rain 18:00. No red warning in Portugal since 15:55. The alert situation to 23:59.

charles-lisbon.text: Observed at 18:00: west-north-west 24 km/h gusting 50 km/h at the airport, 992 hPa and rising; no rain at IPMA's Lisbon stations in the latest hour. No new IPMA communiqué after no. 3 (12:16).

metro.text: The mayor (Tuesday): the Metro runs on Wednesday; no service notice on the Metro's own site at 11:52. Lusoponte (17:30): both bridges back to their usual limits.

madeira.text: IPMA: red warnings ended 06:00; Areeiro 249.5 mm in six hours, 474.7 in twelve. Regional civil protection, relayed by Lusa: 285 occurrences to about 13:00.

record_note: What the authorities had said, by our record, at the minute the questions were asked (19:05 UTC).
